description: Basic Slicer Plume is the everyday dropdown slicer. Closed, it takes a single line and shows "All" or the values you picked; open, its list covers the cards and charts placed below. Like the native slicer, it can also be shown as a list that stays visible in its frame. Drop one column in Field for a simple list, or several columns for a hierarchy such as Category › Product. Only the field is required, and the default settings never show a watermark. FREE, NO WATERMARK - One-line box: "All" or the chosen values ("+n" when they do not fit), clear button, adjustable height - Menu over the report: the visual's frame is transparent by default; make it taller, bring it to front and turn off its background, and the list opens over the visual below - Menu opening: automatic (below the box when there is room, otherwise full frame), below the box or full frame; maximum height and width - List layout, like the native slicer: values always visible in the frame, "Clear" button and selected count in the header - 2-level hierarchy: expand and collapse, tick a parent to select all its children, partial checkboxes, "Expand all / Collapse all" - Accent-insensitive search (matches shown with their parents expanded), "Select all" row - Multiple, Ctrl-multiple or single selection (the choice closes the dropdown), "Always keep one value selected" - Optional count next to each value, sort by model…
